result.topic_en: Draft of part of Riemann's paper on plane air waves of finite amplitude: how an initially localized disturbance splits into two opposite travelling waves, why compression waves steepen until the differential equations fail, the shock (Verdichtungsstoß) jump condition, and the four possible outcomes of an arbitrary initial discontinuity.
